text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look, Trainer! The street band is 
playing a killer tune!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Gaaah! I wanna try being in a band too!!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What's this, Vodka? You wanna start a 
band...? Can you even play an instrument?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What is it!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm telling you, you can totally do it 
if you just practice!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There are lots of roles in a band, but if 
it were me, I'd go with—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, I'm definitely going with 
vocals!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nobody asked about your personal tastes. 
Don't butt in!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer? If you were to 
join in, which part would you play?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we're on the same wavelength! If I'm 
gonna play an instrument, it's gotta be 
the guitar!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think the driving speed of a 
guitar is the absolute best? Right, 
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOOOM!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And then, when you strum it! That sound is 
just the coolest damn thing ever!
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, nobody's around here, so... I can 
shred on my air guitar with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOOM! Vroom, vroooooom!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! I'm about to show you 
the absolute coolest guitar performance 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Vroom, vroom!! VROOOOOOOOOOM!!

Heading toward the source of the 
commotion, I found Vodka surrounded by a 
large crowd.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scram! I told you to scram! I'm not a 
freak show!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Even you came here...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I got so lost in the 'performance' that by 
the time I realized it... it turned into 
this mess.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, your performance earlier was so 
cool!

Similar cheers and applause erupted from 
the students gathered all around.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: R-Really...? I was... cool...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like hell it is! I told you, I'm not on 
display here!

Vodka yelled that, but she also looked 
somehow happy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of my Trainer! You really 
get it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I hear powerful drums that 
resonate right down in my gut—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You think that's super cool, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Vocals and guitar are definitely cool, 
sure, but the drums are just as kickass, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I really think drums deserve to be more 
popular too, though...
And the next morning—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez, who left a cardboard box dumped in 
front of the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you dump that right there, it's gonna 
get in everyone's way...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait a second. The size, how easy it 
is to hit...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, this'll make a great drum!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It's just thrown out anyway, so let me 
have a little fun with it!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dak-dak-dak-dak... BAM, BAM! BAM, BAM! 
...Ha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, now I'm getting into the groove!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Vodka. Do you know what happened to 
the cardboard boxes stacked here?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"The items for our upcoming bazaar were 
all packed inside, bu... t..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that battered cardboard box over 
there... is it really...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-If you leave it in a place like this, 
anyone would think it's trash!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Trash?! Hey... Check what's inside 
first!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know, so what else was I supposed 
to do?!

And thus, their argument was destined to 
continue until both of them ran out of 
stamina—
